# Openstyle

> Openstyle is a free, open source dictation app for Mac on Apple silicon. Hold a key, talk, let go; it types clean text in the app you use. Speech-to-text runs locally with MLX models, on your own server, or on a cloud provider. There is no account, no cloud service, and no telemetry.

## Links

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle): source code, MIT license
- [Releases](https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle/releases/latest): download the latest .dmg for Apple silicon Macs
- [Landing page](https://maheidem.github.io/openstyle/): screenshots and feature overview

## Key facts

- Free and open source (MIT license)
- macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon (arm64) builds
- Hold a key, talk, let go; the text lands in the app you are typing in
- Models: built-in speech models (Parakeet, Qwen3-ASR, SenseVoice, Whisper, more from Hugging Face) and a built-in text model (Gemma 4), your own server with an OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint (for example oMLX), or a cloud provider with your own API key
- The AI cleanup LLM can run inside the app (built-in Gemma 4), or on oMLX, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server
- First run: "Recommended for your Mac" picks a voice model and a text model that fit the Mac, in one download. "Choose another" offers this Mac, your own server or a cloud provider. "Run setup again" in Settings or the Help menu keeps your data
- Updates: Stable channel by default; an optional Dev channel gives early builds
- Optional AI cleanup of the transcript with an LLM
- Meetings: records (pause and resume), transcribes after the call, writes a summary, speaker detection, folders, tags and search across all meetings. An optional Ask page (experimental, off by default) answers questions about your meetings
- Custom vocabulary and cleanup
- In tests on an idle Apple silicon Mac, Parakeet transcribed a 3-minute recording in under a second (measured October 2026, warm model)
